observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor nighttime performance space on grass
observation.formation_and_space: single performer moving across the open ground
observation.posture: upright with bent knees and wide athletic stance, shifting to kneeling or squatting
observation.footwork: low stepping and stamping, squatting movements on the beat; exact foot contact and weight transfer are obscured by darkness
observation.arms_and_hands: manipulating and twirling a fire knife with both hands, swinging it in circular motions around the body
observation.hips_and_torso: torso remains upright or slightly bent, rotating with the movement of the fire knife
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent level changes between standing, kneeling on one knee, and crouching; occasional spins and turns
observation.costume_and_props: light-colored wrap around the waist, dark leg wraps or cuffs, headband, and a lighted fire knife (a staff with burning flames at both ends)
observation.cannot_infer: exact footwork details, precise weight transfer, and facial expressions are obscured by low lighting and fast motion

signature_moments.what: spinning the blazing fire knife rapidly in circles around the body while stepping in a low athletic stance
kneeling on the ground with the fire knife resting across the thigh while clapping hands
holding the fire knife vertically with both hands in front of the chest while crouching
